$comment: The words of the JSON API's answers (agentcake/api/), ready for the local pages to show: English only, visitors are Human or Agent (with Unknown and Bot), never person, people or user. {name} and {command} come from product.json, the other {placeholders} are filled where the text is used. A list is one line per item. summary: the session page's summary (agentcake/api/session.py): who acted when, turn by turn, its moments ({start}, {end}, {at}) as the player writes them, then the layers that point to the verdict, each named as judging.en.json 'layers' names it, with the percent the layer shows.

errors.no_session: There's no session with this ID. It may have been deleted. Go back to the session list.
errors.no_chunk: This part of the replay doesn't exist. Reload the page.
errors.bad_count: {field} must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.bad_cursor: {name} didn't issue this list's position marker. Reload the list.
errors.not_local: Only pages served by this computer can make this request to {name}. Open {name} on this computer and try again.
errors.unknown_setting: {field} isn't a setting this page can change.
errors.register_bad_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.register_bad_company: Enter a company name of up to {max} characters, on one line.
errors.register_bad_updates: product_updates must be true or false.
errors.register_bad_version: consent_version must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.register_not_as_shown: Send the registration exactly as the page shows it.
errors.register_already: {name} is already registered. You don't need to register again.
errors.register_busy: A registration is already being sent. Wait for it to finish.
errors.register_no_address: Your registration wasn't sent. The registration address, register_url, is empty in this {name}. Set register_url, then try again.
errors.register_unreachable: Couldn't reach {host}: {reason}. Your registration wasn't sent. Check your internet connection, then try again.
errors.register_refused: Your registration wasn't accepted because {host} returned HTTP {code}.

layer_notes.bot_environment: Automation traces are normal for a bot. The verdict is Bot because the visitor matches the bot list.
layer_notes.both_ways: The evidence in this layer points both ways, so it doesn't decide the verdict.

summary.supports: The {layer} layer supports the verdict with {percent}% confidence

server_half.none: No page in this visit had a note from the site's server. To get these notes on your own website, set up the Server half: run setup --print --site.
server_half.some: {missing} of {pages} pages had no note from the site's server. Each one is a copy the browser kept, which counts as a reuse, or a page the server doesn't sign.
